purpose: Pins the ms2-lsg tables the atlas's lineage-specific-gene layers are built from, by commit AND by each table's git blob ID, WITHOUT carrying a single value. scripts/check_ms2_canon.py reads the exact bytes through git at this commit, refuses if a blob ID differs, and then compares every gene in the committed shards against them.
why_pinned_not_vendored: This repo's root is published by GitHub Pages. Pinning keeps the values out of the public tree, and reading through git means a stale or feature-branch checkout cannot feed the check the wrong file: the ms2-lsg clone on this machine is routinely checked out on another session's branch.
why_blob_ids: A commit pin alone churns on every unrelated commit to ms2-lsg main. A blob ID changes only when that table's bytes change, so a moved table fails loudly by name and nothing else does. The same commit and blob IDs anchor the chapter's data-freeze proposal (session 'canon check', 2026-09-21), so the atlas and the chapter share one anchor.
refresh: move ms2_lsg_commit to the new main, replace each blob ID with `git rev-parse <commit>:<path>`, rerun the check, and read every FAIL before accepting the move
